name: testland/uat-script-author
description: Emits User Acceptance Testing scripts in stakeholder-readable form - pre-conditions, business-language steps, expected business outcome, pass/fail, and an acceptance-criteria map with sign-off. Written for non-developer testers (end users, SMEs, solution owners); one TC per user journey, for compliance / contract / audit records. Use when a release needs formal UAT sign-off as the contractual gate (B2B, regulated industries). For developer-facing scripted cases (step-table or Gherkin) use manual-test-script-author; for a short release-day smoke checklist use test-execution-checklist.
